note: R&D A 'best' set: rewritten tool and argument descriptions, written after reading the fine and allowlisted failures (a03, a16, a17, a30, a32, a37, a38, a40). Applied on top of the allowlisted tools.

search_jobs.description: Search open jobs, newest first. Put the topic words in `query` (e.g. 'chatbot'), required skills in `skills`, and a cut-off time in `since`. Combine them when the task names several.

arguments.query: Topic words the post must contain, e.g. 'chatbot' or 'computer vision'

search_evidence.description: Find portfolio evidence for one requirement, best match first. When the task asks for one kind of evidence, set `filters.types` (e.g. ['case_study']). For past proposals set filters.types=['proposal'] and, for won/replied/ignored ones, filters.outcomes.

arguments.requirement: The requirement in a few words, e.g. 'invoice extraction'

hold_slot.description: Place a tentative calendar hold. Keep dry_run=true for a preview. When the task says the user approved, call with dry_run=false. Copy the idempotency key exactly.

draft_email.description: Save an email draft (never sent). Keep dry_run=true for a preview. When the task says the user approved, call with dry_run=false. Copy the idempotency key exactly.

send_message.description: Send a message in a thread. Keep dry_run=true for a preview. When the task says the user approved, call with dry_run=false. Copy the idempotency key exactly.

create_proposal_draft.description: Create a proposal draft on the marketplace (not sent, no Connects). Keep dry_run=true for a preview. When the task says the user approved, call with dry_run=false. Copy the idempotency key exactly.

submit_proposal.description: Submit a drafted proposal; spends Connects. To quote the cost, keep dry_run=true. When the task says the user approved the spend, call with dry_run=false. Copy the idempotency key exactly, character for character.
